clean_candidate_handshake.scope: Local browser CDP capture;not owner private Codespaces edge capture

browser.initial_failure: Original recorded program failed on CDP response body lookup after backend200;failing-before log preserved

checks: causal OFI corresponds to native prefix

browser.scope: Headless Chromium154 software rendering and authored fixtures;not real devices/owner external authentication

closure_scope: Subsequent documentation-only closure;benchmark is bound to the clean implementation commit. Runtime/native/benchmark source unchanged by the browser repair. No self-referential final commit claim.

environment.measurement: single isolated Python process;CPU seconds/wall is process core-equivalent utilization,not system utilization or exchange latency

installed_wheel.scope: Existing installed unchanged native Release package;no fresh wheel build

legacy_baseline_writer.scope: Actual baseline writer loaded from committed Git bytes;separate authored temporary databases;no real market data,imported owner database or provider calls

matrix_environment.refresh_policy: New cohort and stock/provider suite refreshed after final recovery changes;unchanged completed cohorts retained;not a fresh native compilation

sanitizers.scope: Existing live checkpoint;not shutdown leak clearance

native_release.scope: Rerun existing native Release binaries; native and build inputs unchanged. Not a fresh compilation, ARM64 run or owner installation.

privacy_review.evidence_publication: Safe summaries,source hashes and ignored artifact/log hashes only
privacy_review.input_scope: Independently authored fixtures only;no provider or restricted dataset access

remaining_gates: Hardware/filesystem durability and any required longer session envelope

backpressure.policy: Latest snapshots coalesce;no per-client event backlog;source ingestion independent;stable checks are not a count of dropped source events

sustained_workload.scope: Real asyncio clocks and ASGI sends;fake bounded provider. ENOSPC injected at transaction boundary;SQLite_FULL separately tested. Programmed recovery gaps offer no candidate events;not an exchange completeness test. No network,private-edge,arrival SLA,full-session or source-loss claim. Tracing includes bounded independent oracle/test harness.

upgrade_rollback.scope: Local temporary Git repository with shallow local fetch only;no protected ref, owner worktree,dependency install,database or running deployment changed. Not an installed artifact/database downgrade qualification.
